~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ site01-hub28 building router hsrp ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### USER PREFIX START ########### 
!
vlan {Vlan_ID_user}
  name {net_type_4_Vlan_name}
!
interface {int_name_A}{int_#}
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add {Vlan_ID_user}
!
interface vlan{Vlan_ID_user}
  description {net_type_4_Vlan_name}
  mtu 9216
  ip vrf forwarding {net_type_4_VRF_name}
  ip address {{User_Prefix_last_IP}-1} {User_prefix_netmask}
  standby ip  {User_Prefix_last_IP}
  standby preempt
  standby priority 105
  standby authentication md5 key-string 0 {key_word}
  no shutdown
!
!copy running startup
!
! ########### USER PREFIX END ############# 


~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ site02-hub28 building router hsrp ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### USER PREFIX START ########### 
!
vlan {Vlan_ID_user}
  name {net_type_4_Vlan_name}
!
interface {int_name_L}{int_#}
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add {Vlan_ID_user}
!
interface vlan{Vlan_ID_user}
  description {net_type_4_Vlan_name}
  mtu 9216
  ip vrf forwarding {net_type_4_VRF_name}
  ip address {{User_Prefix_last_IP}-2} {User_prefix_netmask}
  standby ip  {User_Prefix_last_IP}
  standby preempt
  standby priority 100
  standby authentication md5 key-string 0 {key_word}
  no shutdown
!
!copy running startup
!
! ########### USER PREFIX END ############# 


~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ bldg05-sw01-04 building distribution switch ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### USER PREFIX START ########### 
!
vlan {Vlan_ID_user}
  name {net_type_4_Vlan_name}
!
interface Port-channel{int_#}
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add {Vlan_ID_user}
!
interface {int_name_A}{int_#}
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add {Vlan_ID_user}
!
interface {int_name_L}{int_#}
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add {Vlan_ID_user}
!
!copy running startup
!
! ########### USER PREFIX END #############
